cmd.cleanJavaWorkspace: Clean Java Language Server Workspace (with retry)
cfg.title: Java Module Manager
cfg.pinned: Optional: pinned base modules (matched by `artifactId` or folder name) that always stay enabled and cannot be unchecked. Empty by default = all modules can be closed; closing a module that others depend on still triggers a warning.
cfg.depth: Maximum directory depth to scan for pom.xml files.
cfg.colorDesc: Color used for closed module folders (badge and label) in the Explorer.
